reduction_concentration.evidence: Cells (~107) containing 2 mg of protein, were treated by 100 µl of lysis buffer (7 M urea, 2 M thiourea, 4% CHAPS, 1% dithiothreitol (DTT), 2% (v/v) ampholytes, pH 3-10, protease inhibitor mixture).

The samples in the lysis buffer were mixed with rehydrating buffer (7 M urea, 2 M thiourea, 2 % CHAPS, 0.3% DTT, 0.5% IPG (v/v) buffer, pH 3-11 NL, 0.001% bromophenol blue) in final volume of 125 µl (250 µg of protein) / strip.
After IEF, strips were soaked 10 min in the equilibration solution (50 mM Tris, pH 8.8, 6 M urea, 2% sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDS) and 30% (v/v) glycerol, 1% DTT).
For complete reduction, 300 µL of 3 mM DTT, 100 mM ammonium bicarbonate was added to each sample and incubated at 50°C for 15 minutes.
